objective: Implement strict region-qualified Phase 3 presence value types and manual little-endian payload codecs, without activating protocol 2 in the ROM/Lua bridge yet.
closed_decisions: Keep the 144-byte bridge frame, 128-byte payload, existing message IDs, and bridge ABI 1. This unit defines protocol-2 payload contracts but does not change any global protocol/build constant or C/Lua/Rust sidecar codec.

PresencePoseV1 is exactly 24 bytes: WorldLocation bytes 0..10, elevation 10, direction 11, client_tick u32 at 12, nonzero warp_sequence u32 at 16, movement_mode 20, animation_id 21, avatar_id 22, player_state 23. WorldLocation remains region-qualified and rejects Unspecified or uncatalogued region/map pairs.

LocalPresenceStateV1 is exactly 28 bytes: pose at 0..24 and nonzero source_sequence u32 at 24. RemotePlayerSpawnV1 is 72 bytes: nonzero u64 handle at 0, nonzero server sequence at 8, local state at 12, canonical lowercase ASCII username zero-padded to 32 bytes at 40. Update is 40 bytes, despawn 16 bytes with three zero reserved bytes, and interaction 20 bytes using handle, observed server/warp sequence, and signed observed coordinates.

Use manual little-endian encode/decode with exact lengths and no transmute/unsafe/host-layout assumptions. Reject nonzero reserved bytes, invalid username padding, unknown enum values, zero handles/sequences/warp values, unspecified regions, and invalid regional map identities before returning a value.

Allow direction ordinals south=1,north=2,west=3,east=4; movement idle=0,walk=1,run=2; animation idle=0,locomotion=1; avatar Brendan=1,May=2; player state hidden=0,overworld=1; despawn reasons hidden=1,stale=2,disconnected=3,lease-invalid=4,replaced=5,partition-left=6. Unknown values fail closed.

PresenceHandle is opaque, nonzero, and serializes in human-readable formats as exactly 16 lowercase hexadecimal digits, never a JSON integer. Sequence comparison follows RFC 1982: delta is nonzero and strictly below 0x80000000; the ambiguous half range is not newer. Increment helpers skip zero.

Canonical usernames reuse the existing account contract: 3..=32 lowercase ASCII bytes, alphanumeric first/last, and only lowercase letters, digits, underscore, dot, or hyphen inside. After the first zero byte, every remaining username byte must be zero.

Expose documented constants for every size/offset and include golden vectors whose bytes can be reused verbatim by later C and Lua units. Add serde strictness tests where public types serialize; deny unknown fields for structured human-readable forms.

acceptance_criteria.description: All six presence payload/value contracts encode and decode exact documented little-endian sizes and offsets, with deterministic golden vectors and no unsafe or layout casts.
Every region, map, reserved byte, username, enum, handle, sequence, warp, and exact-length invariant fails closed without partially accepted values.
RFC 1982 tests cover normal order, duplicates, stale values, wrap, zero, and the ambiguous half range; increment helpers skip zero.
Presence handles round-trip as fixed lowercase hexadecimal strings in JSON and reject numeric, uppercase, short, long, malformed, and zero representations.
Protocol tests, strict clippy, formatting, locked metadata, and diff checks pass with changes confined to owned_files.

forbidden_changes: Do not edit Cargo manifests/lock, cloud/server/sidecar/launcher, C/ROM, Lua/bridge, generators/manifests, documentation outside this contract, or orchestration artifacts.

Do not activate or bump the global game protocol/build, change existing bridge frame/message IDs, weaken WorldLocation catalog validation, add dependencies, unsafe Rust, allow attributes, unbounded strings/vectors, or compatibility fallbacks for the legacy 16-byte player state.
Do not stage, commit, branch, fetch, pull, push, contact remotes, create/remove worktrees, or revert another worker's edits.

return_when: Every acceptance criterion is resolved and verification outcomes are recorded.
An exact layout or existing public API conflict requires changing a closed decision or crossing owned_files.
